thread:
mike: Quick note seeing fncall validation rejects routed to fallback in ap-south-1. Model cost looks normal but fallback_count up. Anyone else?

anya: Example log: `WARN validate: req=pk1 reason=missing_field field=tool.args.customer_id route=primary->fallback`

jordy: Thats usually the model emitting a different schema. Current problem: console only shows variant traffic, not validation routing. Product confused.

mike: We should emit metric fncall_validation_total{route,reason,outcome,slice} and a trace tag validation.reason + fallback_model.

billing-bot: billing: tag idea: add event field validation_status=routed so billing pipeline can decide. No automatic charge change.

anya: Also add a samples API `/samples?reason=missing_field&route=fallback` returning redacted examples. Redact keys named email, token, ssn, phone.

ui-team: UI plan: small probe on model page "Validation routed" sparkline + top reasons. Click -> samples. Tooltip explaining routing and canary context.

jordy: Alert rule: if rate(routed)/rate(requests) by (route) > 0.01 for 5m AND token_spike>10% -> page oncall.

mike: Watch cardinality: reason enum should be small (missing_field, extra_props, type_error, parse_error). slice values limited.

anya: Ill draft RFC with metric names, sample rates (default sample=0.05) and billing tagging. Canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC for ap-south-1.

billing-bot: deploy-note: feature/validation-metrics queued to staging by anya.

mike: Thanks all  followups in RFC thread.
